notes.title: New game with clear data
notes.content:
Thank you for playing.
We are pleased to announce that the new game feature has been added to the game.

[b][New game with clear data][/b]
You must have the save data that cleared EP15.

[b][method of operation][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551164/244b182e0b6bc257d842fdb289be610a1e956b55.png[/img]
If the save data that cleared EP15 exists, the NEWGAME on the title screen will be
It has changed to "NEW / AGAIN

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551164/ab38274893850d560c7e492eb0e90e87a49d49e0.png[/img]
When you select "NEW / AGAIN", the "Take over New Game" item will appear.
You can select the item to play the new game.

notes.title: Disabling the fifth crystal slot.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing.
Currently, when you learn the member skill "Crystal Slot +1
There was an issue where the fifth crystal slot was also opened.
This fix will be made later this week.

This fix will be applied to all previous play data.
As a precaution, please do not equip crystals in the 5th slot.

The 5th crystal will be returned to your inventory, but there is a possibility that it may be lost. Thank you for your attention in advance.

[b]Date and time[/b]
Saturday, September 26

With this update, the fifth crystal slot will be disabled.
The fifth crystal will be returned to your inventory.

notes.title: Restrictions on Video Distribution
notes.content:
We would like to ask for the cooperation of all those who provide video streaming services.
(Information as of 09/08)

[b]■The part that is acceptable for distribution[/b]
Video streaming up to EP14
Screenshots up to EP14 (posted on SNS)

[b]■Points where distribution is restricted for a period of time[/b]
Distribution of videos of the scenario part from EP14 onwards and posting on SNS
Extra episodes (The Zaston Harbor Murders, Fluorescent Ties) 

The above restrictions will be lifted from October 10, 2020.
Even after the restriction is lifted, the word "Spoiler" will be added to the caption of the video.
　We would appreciate it if you could describe what you understand.
　Please do the same for social networking sites.

We're very happy about the video feed itself, but
We would appreciate it if you would be considerate of spoilers for a certain period of time.
As for what has already been filmed, we will temporarily keep it private.
We would appreciate it if you could publish it after the restriction is lifted.
Thank you for your cooperation.

For more details about the distribution rules, please refer to
Please check out the guidelines for video distribution on our website.

http://rrr3.jp/game/game.html

R3GameCreate
Yui

notes.title: Release News and Future Plans
notes.content:
Good evening, everyone.
I'm Yui, the developer of this game.
I'm sorry for the delay, but we've successfully released the game on August 31st.
I would like to thank you all again for making this game available.

I'm very happy to see that many of you are already playing the game.
Due to the intricate game system, we are finding unexpected glitches.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We would like to share the following information about future developments.

[b]▼To be updated soon[/b]
-Additional Quests (Defeat the bosses and get a lot of Hunt Points, and if you're lucky, crystals!
-Planned to add places to enter item codes in Varga and D.H.

[b]▼Plans for improvement in the future[/b]
-Improvement of usability around the customization shop
-The ability to view the order history of fixed quests, etc.
-Even characters who are being held back get a little bit of weapon experience.
etc.

Thank you!

R3GameCreate
Yui

notes.title: 8/27-8/31 start
notes.content:
Nice to meet you all.
This game was created as a personal production.
I run a website called R3GameCreate.
I'm Yui, the author of Grand Intention.

It's my first time to play on Steam.
We're working on a release, but we've been fumbling around.
We'll be releasing it between 8/27-8/31, so stay tuned!

I was surprised to see so many community registrants already.
Thank you all!
Even after the release, we will continue to update the game to make it more comfortable to play, 
so we're going to make sure that you can play
Please feel free to let me know if you have any problems or requests.

Unfortunately, this game is only available in Japanese.
However, if there is a great response, we will consider English language support as well, so we ask for your support.

I will be inviting you all to travel soon.
Thank you!

R3GameCreate
